title: Composing Unbalanced Flows for Flexible Docking and Relaxation / FlexDock (ICLR 2025)
tldr_zh: 提出 Unbalanced Flow Matching 松弛边缘约束，链式 apo→holo 对接 + 全原子松弛，PoseBusters 合格率 30%→73%
tldr_en: Unbalanced Flow Matching relaxes marginal constraints for easier couplings; chained apo-to-holo manifold docking plus all-atom relaxation lifts PoseBusters validity from 30% to 73%
